chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: The audition at La Conga and the blown fuse
summary: Machito and Mario formed a band to audition at La Conga but the lights went out and a rival bandleader got the job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Okay. There came a time in 1939 when
you wanted to direct your own band. Tell me what happened?

Well, you know, I am very, very, I don't know, I had the go and get it. In those days I was very shy and make friends with everyone because you know I am very flexible, so I met a lot of so many people and they - "Why don't you organize your own band?", so on, so on, and so on, but I was conservative in a way and in account that Orquesta Siboney was a cooperative and they was a bunch of nice guys.
No, before La Siboney, I believe Mario was out of a job, he wasn't with Chick Webb and you and him decided to.....
We organize a band.
......organize a band and you went and you tried to get the job at La Conga.
Absolutely.
Okay. One of the guys in your band, in your band, was Alberto Iznaga, because he told me. He told me that at that time he was in Augusto Coen's band......
Right.
........and because he made some arrangements for you, Augusto Coen fired him.
Uh Huh
Okay. Ahh, what happened at La Conga Club, why didn't you get that job?
One band leader......
He is a band leader today?
No, no, he died.
Okay.
Ahhh - he was so anxious to work at that particular place that he even bought the piano for the place and when we went to the audition, they took the------
The light fuse?
The light fuse, and we had no light. It was all completely illuminated when we got there and when we were start playing, the light went out and we just cannot give the .......
The audition.
The audition, and then, you know, we were kind of disgusted. We didn't think that that could happen.
That nobody would pull a trick like that.
Absolutely. So we went out and I say okay, so Mario ahh - Doc Cheatham got sick and Mario, Calloway was looking for Mario and Mario got Doc Cheatham's place.
Yeah, but the band leader got the job, right? Your group didn't get it.
No.
The other guy, he happened to find the light fuse.
Oh yes, yes, they found the fuse and everything. There was no outing, no audition or listened, anything because it was the piano, a brand new piano, he was a well-to-do fellow.
